cohort: The study cohort consisted of 317 infertile women (mean age 28.82 years) undergoing hysterosalpingography (HSG) examinations as part of an infertility workup.
finding: Pelvic surgeries, especially cesarean operations, are associated with an increased risk of developing subsequent fallopian tube abnormalities and pelvic adhesions, which can lead to infertility.
mod_finding: Cesarean operations were specifically highlighted as a type of pelvic surgery that increases the risk of subsequent fallopian tube abnormalities and pelvic adhesions.
